gen-silkscreen-switzer: Silkscreen spaces its pixel letters so loosely you can almost feel the gaps, like spaghetti laid out in type. And Switzer follows with tubular, wire-like strokes and a tall waist line, so a long paragraph moves along smoothly.
gen-silkscreen-work-sans: Silkscreen is lo-fi and retro, each letter floating in its own pocket of space. But Work Sans, a plain sans with a high mean line and joins as thick as its strokes, is what really makes the pairing.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-tc: Fat, confident and round, with a clear channel leading into every curved letter and no hairline shift in the stems. Noto Sans TC keeps a long passage moving with wide counters and outward-opening curves.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Audiowide has a futuristic, tech feel, with arms and legs of constant width and glyphs laid out like tiles with wide grout lines. Noto Sans Kannada works well at a modest size beside it.
gen-almendra-display-switzer: Almendra Display brings an ornate, literary feel, with a pronounced x-height and letters that never seem to pinch shut. Switzer sits below it in tubular, wire-like strokes, a tall waist line making it look crisp at a modest size.
gen-gf-offside-gf-yaldevi: Curves that refuse to close, spread out in widely tracked, level lines. Offside holds the attention as a heading, while Yaldevi, a sans-serif with outsized lowercase and an e that opens clearly to the right, does the quiet work of being read.
gen-tourney-gf-abeezee: Tourney cuts every stroke to one width and stretches its words with wide tracking, bulky small letters and all. ABeeZee follows with terminals that finish well clear of the stem, so a long passage reads like neon glass tubing.
gen-tourney-gf-alexandria: Every stroke is cut to one width, then stretched out wide. Tourney sets the athletic tone up top, and Alexandria, a sans-serif with open c terminals and a tall body, takes over once the text starts running.
gen-tourney-gf-anek-devanagari: Anek Devanagari is a sans-serif with distinctly open letter mouths and a tall middle zone, which gives Tourney's bulky, widely tracked headings plenty of room. Anek Devanagari carries the text at low contrast while the heading keeps joins no thinner than the stems.
gen-tourney-gf-anek-kannada: Anek Kannada is a sans-serif whose x-height reaches high like a squared-off woodblock letter, with terminals stopping far from the stem. But Tourney does the loud work, wide-tracked and cut at the constant weight of a stencil channel.
